name: Thomas Edison
hook: Menlo Park's "invention factory" and the inventions Jeopardy credits him with.

facts.label: Menlo Park, New Jersey
facts.statement: Edison worked at his Menlo Park, New Jersey laboratory — the "invention factory" — where the Edison Memorial Tower now stands.

facts.label: the phonograph
facts.statement: Edison invented the phonograph in 1877; his first recording was a line from "Mary Had a Little Lamb."

facts.label: the incandescent light bulb
facts.statement: Edison's practical incandescent bulb, perfected in 1879, became his signature invention and the basis of his fame.

facts.label: General Electric
facts.statement: Edison's electric light company combined with Thomson-Houston in 1892 to form General Electric.

facts.label: the 99 percent perspiration quote
facts.statement: Edison's most quoted line: "Genius is one percent inspiration and 99 percent perspiration."

facts.label: Milan, Ohio
facts.statement: Edison was born in Milan, Ohio — a village named for the Italian city but pronounced to rhyme with "stylin'."

facts.label: motion pictures
facts.statement: Edison's studio filmed the first sporting event ever shot, an 1894 boxing match, and made a 1909 film of Mark Twain.
